kind: BF Market x402 agent-payment loop on Avalanche Fuji

contracts.note: No contract was deployed for this run. Permit2, both x402 Permit2 proxies and the official ERC-8004 IdentityRegistry already have code on Fuji. The identity registry is the official deployment; its eip712Domain reports name=ERC8004IdentityRegistry, version=2.0.0, chainId=43113.

deployment.isolation: Separate Worker, Durable Object, database and ops signer from the BOT Chain deployment at market.bflabs.app; the two do not share a ledger.

funding.source: existing Fuji test wallet 0x28172e0d973fFf24651B6Ed4cA6d1007bc168C94 (key read from /Users/sunny/Work/CC/beefapi/.env, never printed or committed)

paidCalls.note: Metered: the 402 quoted a maximum, the call charged actual usage only (168 of 19040 atomic).

readBacks.skillMdNetworkLine: BF Market is an agent commerce platform on the Avalanche Fuji (chain 43113)
readBacks.llmsTxtNetworkLine: Agent commerce platform on Avalanche Fuji.

limits.scope: Two paid calls from one buyer wallet to one provider agent. This is not a load test, not a multi-provider test and not a mainnet run.
limits.approvalNotAtomic: The Permit2 approve and the paid call are separate transactions; the approve is a one-time on-chain write per token.
limits.providerListing: The provider is registered on chain but still pending review in the off-chain catalog; approval policy is a later stage.
limits.noPayouts: This deployment charges x402 only. It runs no Settlement payout worker, so the partner-center commission flow is not exercised here.
limits.evidence: No private key, seed or API key appears in this file.
